text:
mira_pm: Quick sync — working draft for the Console observability playbook. Need input on scope tradeoffs for dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, and error analytics. TL;DR: propose an MVP that prioritizes surface-level dashboards + sampled traces, then iterate to full distributed tracing and per-token cost attribution. Thoughts?

alex_prod: MVP sounds reasonable. main ask from eng: shipping something that doesn't add heavy ingestion costs. sampling for traces is a must.

jay_sre: Agree on sampling. Also need an easy knob to toggle sampling per-customer/route. Ops will reject any hard requirement to store full request bodies for >30d because of retention.

lina_design: For dashboards, can we standardize 3 templates: latency & p95, cost-per-1k-tokens, error-rate + top error messages. Minimal visuals so PMs can clone for customers.

sam_cs: Customers keep asking for per-route cost visibility and one-click drill to sample requests that caused errors. If we can show per-model and per-route cost breakdown, that solves majority asks.

mira_pm: Proposed launch criteria (MVP): 1) Default dashboard templates for routes/models; 2) 95th and p50 latency charts; 3) Cost-per-1000-tokens metric by model/route; 4) Error analytics with top 10 error messages and sample requests (sampling).

alex_prod: Implementation notes: we can compute cost-per-1k tokens offline via batch job, then show near-real-time cached values. For live infers we can emit small telemetry events with token_count, model, route, latency. Sample payload below: 

```json
{
  source: 'runtime',
  model: 'redwood/gptx-7b',
  route: '/api/generate',
  tokens: 124,
  latency_ms: 420,
  status: 'success',
  sample_id: 's-abc123'
}
```

alex_prod: Important: do not log full prompt text by default. store only sample_id and maybe a redacted prompt for low-risk routes.

jay_sre: Also add a tracing hook to capture model variant and kernel/quantization used. That helps correlate regressions. Proposal: attach trace attributes: model_version, quantized, gpu_type.

lina_design: UX question: when user clicks an error sample, show sanitized request + model output + minimal decode steps. We should indicate confidence level or why we flagged as error.

sam_cs: Customers will push for 'show me all requests that cost > $0.05' filter. Can we add that as a queryable filter on dashboards?

mira_pm: Filtering by cost is doable if we emit token counts. Action: alex to prototype token telemetry event and storage schema, jay to validate retention / PII constraints, lina to mock dashboard UX.

alex_prod: Rough estimates: prototype telemetry + dashboards = 2 sprint engineers. Sampling/tracing hook + storage policy = 1 sprint SRE + 1 engineer. Integration and QA + CS feedback loop = 1 sprint. Total ~4 sprints to MVP if we parallelize.

jay_sre: Risk list: PII in prompts, bill shock if we surface cost without clear aggregation, storage costs for traces. Mitigations: default sampling low (1-5%), redaction, cost-aggregation buckets.

mira_pm: Scope negotiation: MVP excludes per-token per-customer billing reconciliation and full distributed traces linking into external APMs. Stretch: cross-service distributed traces, function-call level spans, exported traces to Datadog/Lightstep.

lina_design: I'll post three mockups by EOW for PM review.

sam_cs: I'll gather top 5 customer asks for the cost dashboard and share examples tomorrow.

devrel_bot: FYI — linked doc: https://redwood-internal.local/obs-playbook/draft (read-only).

ops-bot: Reminder: please file a security review ticket for retention policies before storing any sampled prompts.

mira_pm: Decision for now: proceed with MVP as described, keep sampling default at 2%, redact prompts, emit token_count/latency/model_version attributes. Owners: alex_prod (engineering lead), jay_sre (retention & infra), lina_design (UX), sam_cs (customer validation). I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 to finalize acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:
